title: Atlanta Cyclorama Moves to New Home
content: If the Atlanta Cyclorama were laid out flat, it would be one of the largest paintings in the world: 40 feet tall and longer than a football field.When properly displayed in its cylindrical format, it's a wraparound experience akin to virtual reality, Small sculpted figures in the foreground to add to the illusion.According to the New York Times, the painting "was prepared in Milwaukee by a team of German artists and was completed in 1886, when cycloramas...were a leading form of entertainment, and the colossal works traveled the country."But over the years, it has fallen into neglect. Fortunately $35 million has been raised to restore it and to move it to a new home.New York Times:On a Mission to save Atlanta's Civil War CycloramaAtlanta History Center
